integrity: Derivation includes exact normalized beta recurrence, weighted-shift singular-value formula and complete limiting estimates. Finite computations are independent consistency checks, not proofs of infinite limits. No external or independent audit has been conducted.
scientific_limitations: Analytic weighted Bergman disk only; sharp indicator and coordinate multiplier. Fixed weight and fixed Schatten exponent as the cutoff approaches the boundary; no smooth-symbol, higher-dimensional or uniform-parameter extension. Priority requires independent literature confirmation.
title: Gamma boundary layer and Schatten phase transitions for Bergman disk-cutoff commutators
